**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 24 sits at our preferred position on every material term:

- **24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent, subject only to prompt notice and assignee assumption.
- **24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness qualified), and never to a direct competitor.
- **24.3** — residual assignments are governed by a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard.
- **24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, plus a cooperation duty for successor administration.

Section 13.3 is consistent, permitting licence transfer to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment. A document-wide search confirms no other change-of-control trigger or deemed-assignment provision. This clause favours us; nothing to flag.
